name: Sugar No. 11
read: Sugar No. 11 Jan 27 options (on MAR 27 futures 17.61, 22 days to expiry 2026-12-15): at-the-money implied vol 27.6%, +3.3 pts vs 2026-11-17. 20-day realized vol 34.4%, so options trade at a discount of 6.8 pts. 25-delta risk reversal +2.3 (calls over puts). Over the last 10 sessions (2026-11-10 to 2026-11-23) call open interest fell 1,454 and puts fell 20,377; put/call OI 0.53 → 0.5, front futures 18.09 → 17.61. Delta-weighted, option holders added about +5,985 futures-equivalent lots in the last 5 sessions (net long exposure bought through options). Front ATM vol 24.1% → 27.6%. Largest Jan 27 strikes: 20 calls (4,124 lots) and 18.5 puts (7,292). Biggest 5-session builds: Mar 27 18.5 calls +4,017; Jul 27 18 calls +3,029. Biggest cut: May 27 25 calls -7,616.
